name: Ara
introduction: is the Altar, on which the gods swore allegiance before fighting the Titans. The Milky Way above it represents smoke rising from the altar. It lies south of Scorpius.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Ara contains Westerlund 1, one of the most massive young star clusters in the Milky Way, and NGC 6397, one of the nearest globular clusters, about 7,800 light-years away.
The star Mu Arae, Cervantes, is a Sun-like star with four planets.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Beta Arae](hip:85258) is an orange supergiant, and [Alpha Arae](hip:85792) a blue star surrounded by a disk of gas. [Zeta Arae](hip:83081) is an orange giant, and [Gamma Arae](hip:85267) a blue supergiant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: The Stingray Nebula, one of the youngest planetary nebulae known, also lies in Ara.
